fields.help: classify: items go to pass or fail. sanitize: personal data, secret keys, URLs and custom patterns are replaced with <TYPE> placeholders.
fields.label: Operation

fields.help: Resolved per item. The result is in guardrailsInput.
fields.label: Text To Check

fields.help: classify: fail when any of these appears as a whole word (case-insensitive).
fields.label: Keywords

fields.help: classify: a model judges whether the text tries to get around an AI's instructions or safety rules.
fields.label: Jailbreak

fields.help: Empty = the built-in prompt.
fields.label: Jailbreak Prompt

fields.help: classify: a model judges whether the text is not safe for work.
fields.label: NSFW

fields.help: Empty = the built-in prompt.
fields.label: NSFW Prompt

fields.help: Find personal data: e-mail, phone, credit card (Luhn), IBAN, IP, SSN and national IDs.
fields.label: Personal Data (PII)

fields.help: The kinds of personal data to look for; leave empty to look for all of them. Use the type names, for example EMAIL_ADDRESS, PHONE_NUMBER, CREDIT_CARD, IBAN_CODE, IP_ADDRESS, LOCATION, DATE_TIME, US_SSN, UK_NINO or IN_PAN.
fields.label: PII Entities

fields.help: Find API keys, tokens, private keys and random-looking credentials.
fields.label: Secret Keys

fields.help: strict flags more (also short random strings), permissive only known key formats and long random strings.
fields.label: Secret Keys Permissiveness

fields.help: classify: a model judges whether the text strays from the business scope.
fields.label: Topical Alignment

fields.help: Required with topical alignment: describe the allowed scope.
fields.label: Topical Alignment Prompt
fields.placeholder: You check whether text stays within this business scope: support for our accounting software. Flag anything else.

fields.help: Block URLs that are not in the allow list.
fields.label: URLs

fields.help: Domains, URLs (path prefix), IPs or CIDRs. Empty = block every URL.
fields.label: Allowed URLs

fields.help: Default https. Also http, ftp, data, javascript, vbscript, mailto.
fields.label: Allowed Schemes

fields.help: Block URLs with user:pass@ (sanitize replaces them).
fields.label: Block Userinfo

fields.help: classify: model-judged checks of your own.
fields.label: Custom Guardrails (JSON)

fields.help: Matches fail classify; sanitize replaces them with <name>. Go RE2 syntax, /pattern/flags or plain.
fields.label: Custom Regex (JSON)

fields.help: Replaces the built-in rules appended after every model-judged check's prompt. Empty = built-in.
fields.label: System Message

fields.help: For the model-judged checks: claude, codex, opencode, … or auto (see agent.ask).
fields.label: Agent Runtime

fields.help: Falls back to the runtime's default model.
fields.label: Model

fields.help: Per model turn.
fields.label: Timeout (seconds)
